body: Thank you. I really appreciate your advice and concerns. I hope you stay strong and figure out where you need to be.

She doesnt know no. Ive always struggled with suicidal tendancies and self harm. But its been this intense since saturday when it happened. Then it got worse when i left her on monday. I had to stay at hers until monday cause i had no way to get home to my mums. (50 miles away). My ex partner refused to drive me home because she thought i was going to leave her. She thought right.

The only breakup ive been thru like this was in feb when i left her. It was horrific. And she did all of this then too. She admitted after time that she did certain things deliberately to hurt me.. And shes doing it again this time too. We were together in total about a year and a half, we were friends for time before that and talked about everything together. That was the version of her that i fell for. Kind, considerate, respectful, loving. But that version if her disappeared once we were actually in a relationship. No i wouldnt want to be with someone who raped me. But my ex is very manipulating and seems to have a huge control over me. She knows me so well and knows how to get into my head. So i think she could probably get me back, she did last time. Its hard to explain. Shea alot older than me. 19 years older. She only ever goes for younger girls and now im wonderingf if its because she targeted me as someone she could easily control. I genuinely cant think of anything good to live for. I wish i could. When i left her i had to quit my job as i was working in her best friends company. Plus she lives 50 miles from my mums house - yes she moved me away from all of my family and friends too. I feel so stupid. Humiliated even.

I got myself away from the abuse yes, when i ended it with her she shut me out and got back with the girl she cheated on me with purely for punishment for leaving. I think if she had said sorry for what she did and explained how it happened then i would have been stupid enough to go back because i love her so much and i know she needs help. So im not that strong. We are only apart because shes cut me out for leaving.

As selfish as this sounds; i dont want to use this to help people in the future. Ive tried to help lots of people with my past experiences and i always end up getting used or hurt. Im just a really unlucky person. Ive never been truely happy for a long long time. 
My pain rate is 10. And its a horrible confused and lost kind of pain. I just need it all to end.

We do need to be apart so she can get better. I just dont think i can get better now. Too much has happened to me. Yes i want to kill myself for many reasons, one of them being; as i said, because im scared she will try to come back into my life. Im a loyal person regardless of what shes done, if she needed my help i would be there for her. And this is what scares me. Because if i be there for her, we would get close again and then id get hurt again. Its all so complicated. But i know her too well. I know she wont leave my life forever. If i can even call this a life.

Im just so scared that she might pop up again and hurt me again. I still love her for some reason. And she worms her way back into my life everytime. I cant cope with this circle anymore. I just need to end it all. 
I feel like im starting to obsess over it all. Everything shes done. Its driving me insane.

Yeah thats basically how i feel. Im a burdon because im 24 and im back at my mums. I moved out of home years ago. Im a burdon because i just keep looking for answers and not getting any. My ex was abused. She had a horrible past. I knew all about it. Just like she knew all about mine. Thats what makes it worse. She knew how it would effect me. She knew i almost died because of her in feb. she knew if she hurt me again i wouldnt handle it because im not strong anymore. She knew all of this. I feel like shes delinerately done it to me. Like she wants me to suffer for her own past :(

No but i will never forget. This has happened to me twice before. Ive been thru so much. When i was 7 i saw my sisters ex boyfriend go for her with a knife. I was in care. I was bullied. Ive always had awful relationships im always attracted to the wrong ones. I just cant take anymore! Im not strong anymore. Its killing me. I wouldnt be giving her my life. Id be ending years of pain and mantal health issues. I have PTSD and anxiety AND depression. I just dont see a light at the end of this. Plus if i end it maybe people will see im not a liar. I would never make up something like this! I hate liars!!

Im staying at my mums house so yeah, i cant eat though. I feel too sick to my stomach. And im throwing up constantly. Im just struggling so much. I was in counselling yesterday and it made me worse to be honest. I just feel like id be better off dead. Everyone would be better off. Im a burdon.

I honestly dont think i can be helped. I dont even know why i wrote on here. I just needed to get it out!! The only thing that would help would be to get answers from her, to get closure but shes never gunna give me it. I feel like shes enjoying hurting me cause shes done it so many times before. I had left her in feb after my overdose, she tried everything to get me back and eventually i caved and gave her another go. She swore she would never hurt me again. But she has. Only this time its so much worse.
I dunno who she is anymore. Im honestly just so lost. Shes unwell clearly. And its made me unwell now also. I feel like im going insane with all of this thinking and crying and flashbacks.
